title: Context-budget team config
description: Schema for docs/conventions/context-budget.yaml, the repository layer of context-budget settings. Hook enablement follows docs/contracts/hook-enablement/README.md: an explicit userConfig value wins over this file.

context_budget_enabled.description: Repository default for the live context breakdown module (pane, above-prompt band, and /context-budget command). An explicit userConfig value wins over this setting. When off, nothing draws or measures regardless of live_display.
